description.en: A graphite reset instrument for user-level Pi tool policies and bounded recovery.
description.zh: 石墨复位器，呈现用户级 Pi 工具策略与有界恢复。

name.en: Interrupted contacts and a single return

description.en: Paired contact stops and one returning trace, pressed into warm mineral paper. The open circuit and short reset path echo bounded recovery; their geometry belongs to this instrument, without copying another project's circuit grid.
description.zh: 暖矿物纸底上压印成对的触点断口和一条返回轨迹，呼应有限的恢复机会。纹理、细颗粒和柔和投影独立于透明标志。

transform.method: Uniformly fit complete motif linework into 432px, leaving a transparent 40px tile perimeter. No clipped paths or recolored project artwork.

hero.method: Authored canvas composition of the complete approved foreground and project-specific supporting texture; no new model call during kit assembly, no crop or recolor

sourceScope: The owner approved the exact generated image and authorized source README/identity adoption. Package 0.1.2 is unchanged. This kit composes the approved foreground; it does not prescribe a product UI palette.

appliesTo: hexly.ai project introduction and brand archive
Hexly-authored promotional video, deck, social and campaign material
scope.officialProjectIdentity: Preserve adopted shape, proportions, material colors and exact file bytes.
scope.productUI: No independent product UI or evidenced application color tokens. Hexly campaign tokens do not prescribe them.
scope.campaignInterpretation: The approved instrument is adopted as the first project identity. Hero layouts and motif textures are separately authored Hexly campaign interpretations.
scope.localAccent: Use only sampled artwork accents without modifying the Logo.

campaignInterpretation.description: The owner-approved source-adopted foreground is reused without recoloring or redrawing. Wide/mobile Hero layouts and theme textures are separate Hexly campaign compositions.
